definition_en: a group of higher primates including apes and humans, or resembling a human in form
core_image: 一张似人非人的脸，从树丛里望出来
scene: 雨林观察站里，幼猿学着研究员的样子摆弄相机背带。Researchers watched the anthropoid apes use simple tools in the wild.
sceneCN: 这里 anthropoid 是「类人猿」（第 1 个义项：高等灵长类动物）；句意为研究人员观察类人猿在野外使用简单工具。

由本词加 -ism 构成，义为「似人状态」

senses.title: A higher primate resembling humans
senses.definition: a primate of the group that includes monkeys, apes, and humans, especially the manlike apes
senses.definitionCN: 包括猴、猿与人的高等灵长类，尤指形似人的猿类
senses.example: The anthropoids at the sanctuary learned to crack nuts with stones.
senses.exampleCN: 保护区里的类人猿学会了用石头砸坚果。
senses.why: Greek anthropos 'human' plus -oid 'resembling' names the apes by their humanlike shape.
senses.whyCN: 希腊语 anthropos「人」加 -oid「类似」按「形似人」来命名这类猿。

senses.title: Resembling a human in form
senses.definition: shaped like or resembling a human being
senses.definitionCN: 形状像人、与人相似
senses.example: The robot has an anthropoid frame with jointed arms.
senses.exampleCN: 这台机器人有带关节手臂的类人体架。
senses.why: The adjective keeps the pure comparison: anything with a human silhouette can be called anthropoid.
senses.whyCN: 形容词保留纯粹的类比：任何拥有人形轮廓之物都可称 anthropoid。

intro.en: Anthropoid joins Greek anthropos 'human being' with -oides 'form, resemblance': manlike.
intro.cn: anthropoid 由希腊语 anthropos「人」加 -oides「形状、相似」构成：似人的。

items.en: The root *bher- meant 'to carry', and anthropos may combine it with an upward sense: 'he who carries himself upright'.
items.cn: 词根 *bher- 意为「承担」，anthropos 或许将它与向上义结合：「直立承担者」。

items.en: Anthropos was the ordinary Greek word for a human being.
items.cn: anthropos 是希腊语中「人」的普通称呼。

items.en: The suffix -oides meant 'having the form of', like eidos 'shape'.
items.cn: 后缀 -oides 意为「具有……之形」，与 eidos「形状」同源。

items.en: Zoologists formed Anthropoidea as the name of the higher-primate group in the nineteenth century.
items.cn: 十九世纪动物学家以 Anthropoidea 命名高等灵长类。

items.en: In everyday English anthropoid mostly means the great apes; in robotics it revives the manlike sense.
items.cn: 日常英语中 anthropoid 多指大型猿类；机器人学中「似人」义复苏。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers the anthropos family and the -oid suffix family; the near-meaning group gathers humanlike words.
note.cn: 形近组收 anthropos 词族与 -oid 后缀家族；近义组收「似人」类词。

entries.definition: The study of humankind; same anthropos root.
entries.definitionCN: 人类学；同一 anthropos 词根。

entries.definition: A humanlike robot; shares the -oid resemblance suffix with a different root.
entries.definitionCN: 人形机器人；共享 -oid 后缀，词根不同。

entries.definition: A collection of writings; begins alike but the root is anthos 'flower'.
entries.definitionCN: 选集；开头相像，但词根是 anthos「花」。

entries.definition: The family of great apes and humans and their ancestors.
entries.definitionCN: 义为「人科」，包括大猿、人及其祖先。

entries.definition: Giving human traits to gods, animals, or objects.
entries.definitionCN: 义为「拟人的」，把人的特征赋予神、动物或物。

entries.definition: Having human form, especially of robots or aliens.
entries.definitionCN: 义为「人形的」，多用于机器人或外星生物。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the anthropos 'human' root and the -oid 'shaped like' suffix.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子利用 anthropos「人」词根与 -oid「形似」后缀。

normal.en: anthropos + oid: shaped like a human.
normal.cn: anthropos 加 oid：形似人。

normal.en: Anthropology and anthropoid share the human root.
normal.cn: anthropology 与 anthropoid 共享「人」词根。

normal.en: The -oid suffix also gives android, spheroid, and humanoid.
normal.cn: -oid 后缀还见于 android、spheroid、humanoid。

normal.en: Anthropoid apes are gorillas, chimps, and orangutans.
normal.cn: 类人猿包括大猩猩、黑猩猩与红毛猩猩。

normal.en: Anthropomorphic means giving human traits to nonhumans.
normal.cn: anthropomorphic 指把人的特征赋予非人之物。

abstract.en: Picture an ape studying its own hand, almost like yours.
abstract.cn: 想象一只猿端详自己的手，几乎和你的手一样。

abstract.en: Picture a shadow on a wall that could be a man or an ape.
abstract.cn: 想象墙上的影子，是人是猿难以分辨。

abstract.en: Picture a manikin in a shop window with a very human stance.
abstract.cn: 想象橱窗里站姿极像人的假人模特。

examples.en: Anthropoids groom one another to build trust.
examples.cn: 类人猿通过互相梳理建立信任。

examples.en: The film's alien was tall and anthropoid.
examples.cn: 电影里的外星人高大且呈人形。

examples.en: Anthropoid fossils show when apes and humans split.
examples.cn: 类人猿化石揭示了猿与人类分化的年代。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「安司肉pyd」——按人的身司（体态）长的猿，像人的就是「类人猿」

root: 希腊语 anthropos（人）+ -oides（形似）→ 似人的 → 类人猿；与 anthropology、anthropomorphic 同享「人」词根。

sensesIntro.en: One manlike idea gives the zoology noun for higher primates and the general adjective for anything human-shaped.
sensesIntro.cn: 「似人」一义生出动物学名词（高等灵长类）与泛指人形的形容词。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a manlike shape looking back at you from the trees
core.cn: 核心意象：从树丛里回望你的似人之形

branches.en: The zoology line: the apes closest to us in form and mind.
branches.cn: 动物学线：形与心都与我们最近的猿类。

branches.en: The design line: machines built in the human silhouette.
branches.cn: 设计线：按人形轮廓制造的机器。

branches.en: Both measure a thing by how much human shape it holds.
branches.cn: 两者都以「含多少人的形状」来度量一物。

branches.en: The ancestry line: anthropoids mark our shared branch of life.
branches.cn: 谱系线：类人猿标记我们共有的生命分支。

branches.en: The uncanny line: almost human is stranger than fully other.
branches.cn: 诡异线：似人非人比完全陌生更令人不安。

intro.en: The word is a clean Greek compound: anthropos plus -oid, both parts highly productive in English.
intro.cn: 这个词是干净的希腊复合：anthropos 加 -oid，两个成分在英语中都极高产。

definition_en: a scientist who studies humans, their societies, cultures, and physical development
core_image: 坐在村落火堆旁记笔记的田野学者
scene: 火塘边，老人讲完最后一个故事，访问者合上了笔记本。The anthropologist spent three years living among the island's fishing families.
sceneCN: 这里 anthropologist 是「人类学家」（第 1 个义项：研究人及其社会文化的学者）；句意为这位人类学家在岛上渔村生活了三年。

derivatives.zh: 同族基础词，义为「人类学」

senses.title: A student of humankind
senses.definition: an expert who studies human beings, their cultures, societies, origins, and bodies
senses.definitionCN: 研究人类及其文化、社会、起源与体质的专家
senses.example: The anthropologist compared wedding customs on both coasts.
senses.exampleCN: 这位人类学家比较了两岸的婚俗。
senses.why: Anthropos 'human' plus -logy 'study' plus -ist 'person who does' names the person at the center of the discipline.
senses.whyCN: anthropos「人」加 -logy「研究」加 -ist「从事者」，点出了这门学科的中心人物。

senses.title: An applied specialist in other fields
senses.definition: a specialist using anthropological methods in business, medicine, law, or technology
senses.definitionCN: 在商业、医学、法律或科技领域运用人类学方法的专家
senses.example: Tech firms now hire anthropologists to study how users really live.
senses.exampleCN: 科技公司现在雇人类学家研究用户的真实生活。
senses.why: Once the method of watching people in context proved powerful, other fields borrowed the practitioner.
senses.whyCN: 一旦「在真实情境中观察人」的方法被证明有力，其他领域便借用了这一从业者。

intro.en: Anthropologist is anthropology plus the agent suffix -ist, on the Greek root anthropos 'human being'.
intro.cn: anthropologist 由 anthropology 加表人后缀 -ist 构成，词根是希腊语 anthropos「人」。

items.en: The root *bher- meant 'to carry'; anthropos may mean 'he who carries himself upright'.
items.cn: 词根 *bher- 意为「承担」；anthropos 或意为「直立承担之人」。

items.en: Anthropos was the standard Greek word for a human being.
items.cn: anthropos 是希腊语「人」的标准词。

items.en: Greek already combined anthropos and logia for talk about human nature.
items.cn: 希腊语已把 anthropos 与 logia 组合，指关于人性的言谈。

items.en: Anthropology became a science in the nineteenth century, and anthropologist named its practitioners.
items.cn: 人类学于十九世纪成为科学，anthropologist 便指其从业者。

items.en: Today the title covers cultural, social, physical, linguistic, and forensic specialists.
items.cn: 如今该头衔涵盖文化、社会、体质、语言与法医等方向。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers anthropos-family titles and same-suffix agents; the near-meaning group gathers human-science scholars.
note.cn: 形近组收 anthropos 词族头衔与同后缀从业者；近义组收研究人的学者。

entries.definition: An ape or anything manlike; same anthropos root, different suffix.
entries.definitionCN: 类人猿或似人之物；同 anthropos 词根，后缀不同。

entries.definition: A scholar of language and texts; ends alike, different root.
entries.definitionCN: 语文学家；词尾相同，词根不同。

entries.definition: An editor of literary collections; near twins in sound, but the root is anthos 'flower'.
entries.definitionCN: 选集编者；读音近似，但词根是 anthos「花」。

entries.definition: A scientist of modern societies and their institutions.
entries.definitionCN: 研究现代社会及其制度的学者。

entries.definition: A fieldwork writer who describes living cultures.
entries.definitionCN: 以田野调查描述现存文化的学者。

entries.definition: A scientist of past human life through material remains.
entries.definitionCN: 通过物质遗存研究人类过去的学者。

normalIntro.en: These hooks stack the three visible parts: anthropos, -logy, and -ist.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子叠加三个可见成分：anthropos、-logy 与 -ist。

normal.en: anthropos + logy + ist: the person who studies humans.
normal.cn: anthropos 加 logy 加 ist：研究人的人。

normal.en: Anthropology minus -y plus -ist gives the scholar.
normal.cn: anthropology 去 y 加 ist 即学者。

normal.en: Margaret Mead is the classic cultural anthropologist.
normal.cn: 玛格丽特·米德是经典的文化人类学家。

normal.en: Forensic anthropologists identify bones for the police.
normal.cn: 法医人类学家为警方鉴定骸骨。

normal.en: Anth- flower words like anthology are unrelated.
normal.cn: anth-「花」类词如 anthology 与之无关。

abstract.en: Picture a notebook filling with names, kinships, and recipes by firelight.
abstract.cn: 想象火光下记满姓名、亲缘与食谱的笔记本。

abstract.en: Picture a lab table holding a skull, calipers, and a camera.
abstract.cn: 想象实验台上并放的颅骨、卡尺与相机。

abstract.en: Picture a map pinned with fieldwork sites on three continents.
abstract.cn: 想象地图上钉着三大洲的田野点。

examples.en: The anthropologist recorded every festival of the valley.
examples.cn: 这位人类学家记录了山谷里的所有节庆。

examples.en: As an anthropologist, she asks small questions about big things.
examples.cn: 作为人类学家，她以小问题切大主题。

examples.en: Museum anthropologists catalogued the new collection.
examples.cn: 博物馆的人类学家为新增藏品编目。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「安思人口记是」——安下心思把人间百态记录下来的人，就是「人类学家」

root: 希腊语 anthropos（人）+ -logy（研究）+ -ist（从事者）→ 研究人之学者；十九世纪学科建制化后成为正式头衔。

sensesIntro.en: From the academic title the word stretches to applied experts who carry the method into other fields.
sensesIntro.cn: 由学术头衔扩展到把方法带入其他领域的应用专家。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a patient observer living at the edge of another way of life
core.cn: 核心意象：在另一种生活方式边缘长期驻留的耐心观察者

branches.en: The academy line: the scholar of cultures, origins, and bodies.
branches.cn: 学院线：研究文化、起源与体质的学者。

branches.en: The market line: firms and hospitals borrowing the observing eye.
branches.cn: 市场线：企业医院借用这双观察之眼。

branches.en: Both depend on context: humans understood where they live.
branches.cn: 两者都依赖情境：在人的生活之处理解人。

branches.en: Fieldwork separates the anthropologist from the armchair theorist.
branches.cn: 田野工作把人类学家与书斋理论家区分开来。

branches.en: Forensic work shows the title now wears many coats.
branches.cn: 法医工作表明这一头衔如今身兼多职。

intro.en: The word stacks a Greek root with two suffixes: -logy for study and -ist for the person.
intro.cn: 这个词把希腊词根与两个后缀叠合：-logy 表研究，-ist 表从事者。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin family; the entries record the Greek source.

definition_en: the scientific study of human beings, their cultures, societies, origins, and physical development
core_image: 一盏灯下并排放着骨骼、陶片与田野笔记
scene: 博物馆的库房里，学者把新到的织品与老照片摊在长桌上。Anthropology asks what all humans share and what makes each culture unique.
sceneCN: 这里 anthropology 是「人类学」（第 1 个义项：研究人的学科）；句意为人类学追问全人类的共同点与各文化的独特之处。

senses.title: The science of humankind
senses.definition: the academic discipline that studies humans across all times and places, from biology to culture
senses.definitionCN: 研究一切时空之中人类的学科，涵盖生物性与文化
senses.example: Anthropology treats a wedding ring and a wisdom tooth as equal evidence.
senses.exampleCN: 人类学把婚戒与智齿视为同等的证据。
senses.why: Anthropos 'human' plus -logy 'study' is literally 'the study of humans', all of them, everywhere.
senses.whyCN: anthropos「人」加 -logy「研究」，字面即「人的研究」，无所不包。

senses.title: A particular account of human nature
senses.definition: a theory or doctrine about what human beings are, as in philosophy or theology
senses.definitionCN: 哲学或神学中关于人之本质的理论或学说
senses.example: The book's anthropology sees people as storytellers first.
senses.exampleCN: 这本书的人性观首先把人看作讲故事的动物。
senses.why: Because -logy also means a body of teaching, theology and philosophy borrowed the word for their views of the human.
senses.whyCN: -logy 亦可指一套学说，神学与哲学便借该词指各自的人观。

intro.en: Anthropology joins Greek anthropos 'human being' with -logia 'study, discourse': the study of humankind.
intro.cn: anthropology 由希腊语 anthropos「人」加 -logia「研究、论述」构成：人之学。

items.en: The root *bher- meant 'to carry'; Greek anthropos likely means 'the one who carries himself upright'.
items.cn: 词根 *bher- 意为「承担」；希腊语 anthropos 大意是「直立承担者」。

items.en: Anthropos was the common Greek word for a human being, man or woman.
items.cn: anthropos 是希腊语指人的常用词，不分男女。

items.en: The suffix -logia meant 'talk, account, study', as in theology and biology.
items.cn: 后缀 -logia 意为「言谈、论述、研究」，如 theology、biology。

items.en: English used anthropologie early for talk of human nature; the modern science was fixed in the nineteenth century.
items.cn: 英语早期用 anthropologie 谈人性；现代科学意义定型于十九世纪。

items.en: The discipline now splits into cultural, social, linguistic, and biological branches.
items.cn: 该学科如今分为文化、社会、语言与生物等分支。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers anth- words that mean flower and the anthropos family; the near-meaning group gathers human sciences.
note.cn: 形近组收意为「花」的 anth- 词与 anthropos 词族；近义组收研究人的学科。

entries.definition: A collection of writings; near twin in sound, but its root is anthos 'flower'.
entries.definitionCN: 选集；读音为近亲，但词根是 anthos「花」。

entries.definitionCN: 类人猿；共享 anthropos，后缀不同。

entries.definition: The measurement of human bodies, a branch of physical anthropology.
entries.definitionCN: 人体测量学，体质人类学的分支。

entries.definition: The study of modern societies and social institutions.
entries.definitionCN: 研究现代社会与社会制度的学科。

entries.definition: The comparative study of peoples and cultures.
entries.definitionCN: 对各民族与文化的比较研究。

entries.definition: The study of past human life through material remains.
entries.definitionCN: 通过物质遗存研究人类过去的学科。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the two Greek halves and the branches of the discipline.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子利用两个希腊成分以及学科的分支。

normal.en: anthropos + logy: the study of humans, literally.
normal.cn: anthropos 加 logy：字面即「人的研究」。

normal.en: Anthropology covers bones and weddings alike.
normal.cn: 人类学既管骨头也管婚礼。

normal.en: Its branches: cultural, social, linguistic, physical.
normal.cn: 分支：文化、社会、语言、体质。

normal.en: Anthropoid and anthropomorphic share the human root.

abstract.en: Picture a table with a skull, a pot, and a diary side by side.
abstract.cn: 想象桌上并放颅骨、陶罐与日记。

abstract.en: Picture one classroom holding four maps of the same world.
abstract.cn: 想象同一间教室挂着四张同一世界的不同地图。

abstract.en: Picture a lens zooming out until all humans fit inside it.
abstract.cn: 想象镜头拉远，直到全人类都框进画面。

examples.en: She switched from biology to anthropology in her second year.
examples.cn: 她大二时从生物学转到人类学。

examples.en: Anthropology began with travelers' tales of distant peoples.
examples.cn: 人类学始于旅行者对远方民族的记述。

examples.en: The court relied on forensic anthropology to identify the remains.
examples.cn: 法庭依靠法医人类学鉴定遗骸身份。

core.cn: 核心意象：全人类被摊在同一张桌上供人研究

branches.cn: 科学线：田野、博物馆与比较研究。

branches.en: The doctrine line: philosophy and theology state their own anthropology.
branches.cn: 学说线：哲学与神学各有其人观。

branches.en: Both answer the same question: what is a human being?
branches.cn: 两者回答同一问题：人是什么？

branches.cn: 四分支模型把文化、社会、语言与生物性合在一起。

branches.cn: 这门学科只比较文化，不排高低。

In anthology it means flower, a different root.
items.exampleCN: 在 anthology 中意为花，是另一词根。

definition_en: a medicine that kills bacteria or stops them growing, or able to destroy bacteria
core_image: 一个小小的盾牌挡在细胞前，抵御看不见的细菌大军
scene: 药房柜台后，药剂师把药盒递过来叮嘱按时服用。The doctor prescribed a course of antibiotics for the chest infection.
sceneCN: 这里 antibiotic 是「抗生素」（第 1 个义项：杀灭细菌的药物）；句意为医生为胸部感染开了一个疗程的抗生素。

derivatives.zh: 同族词，义为「抗菌的」
同前缀词，义为「抗体」
由本词加 -gram 构成，义为「药敏谱」

senses.title: A bacteria-killing medicine
senses.definition: a drug, often made by or derived from microorganisms, that destroys bacteria or checks their growth
senses.definitionCN: 一种常由微生物产生或衍生的药物，可杀灭细菌或抑制其生长
senses.example: Penicillin was the first antibiotic to change medicine.
senses.exampleCN: 青霉素是第一种改变医学面貌的抗生素。
senses.why: Greek bios 'life' plus anti- 'against' plus -tic gives 'against life'; the word first meant any life-poisoning substance, then narrowed to bacteria.
senses.whyCN: 希腊语 bios「生命」加 anti-「对抗」加 -tic 得「对抗生命」；该词初指一切毒害生命之物，后收窄为对付细菌。

senses.title: Destroying bacteria
senses.definition: able to kill bacteria or prevent their multiplication
senses.definitionCN: 能够杀菌或阻止细菌繁殖的
senses.example: The coating has antibiotic properties that keep wounds clean.
senses.exampleCN: 这层涂层具有抗菌特性，可保持伤口清洁。
senses.why: The adjective keeps the original relation: the substance stands against bacterial life.
senses.whyCN: 形容词保留了本原关系：该物质「对抗」细菌的生命。

intro.en: Antibiotic is built from Greek anti- 'against', bios 'life', and the adjective suffix -tic.
intro.cn: antibiotic 由希腊语 anti-「对抗」、bios「生命」与形容词后缀 -tic 构成。

items.en: The root *gweih3- meant 'to live', the same root that gave Latin vita and Greek bios.
items.cn: 词根 *gweih3- 意为「活」，拉丁语 vita 与希腊语 bios 同出一源。

items.en: Bios meant 'life', and it fills English with biology, biography, and symbiosis.
items.cn: bios 意为「生命」，充斥于英语的 biology、biography、symbiosis。

items.en: Anti- meant 'against, in place of', as in antifreeze and antidote.
items.cn: anti- 意为「对抗、替代」，如 antifreeze、antidote。

items.en: French bacteriologists coined antibiose for life against life: one microbe destroying another.
items.cn: 法国细菌学家造 antibiose，指生命对抗生命：一种微生物毁灭另一种。

items.en: With penicillin in the 1940s, antibiotic named the wonder drugs themselves.
items.cn: 二十世纪四十年代青霉素问世后，antibiotic 用以命名这类灵药。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers anti- and bios words; the near-meaning group gathers germ-fighting substances.
note.cn: 形近组收 anti- 与 bios 词汇；近义组收抗微生物药物。

entries.definition: A protein the body makes against a specific invader; made by you, not in a factory.
entries.definitionCN: 机体针对特定入侵者产生的蛋白；由身体自造而非工厂生产。

entries.definition: The study of life; shares bios with a friendlier prefix.
entries.definitionCN: 生物学；共享 bios，前缀友好得多。

entries.definition: Against decay and infection; ends similarly, but the root is sepsis 'putrefaction'.
entries.definitionCN: 抗感染的；词尾相近，词根是 sepsis「腐败」。

entries.definition: Directed against bacteria specifically, often of soaps and coatings.
entries.definitionCN: 专指对抗细菌，多用于皂类与涂层。

entries.definition: Wider still: against microbes including fungi and viruses.
entries.definitionCN: 更广：对抗包括真菌病毒在内的微生物。

entries.definition: The first great antibiotic, from mold.
entries.definitionCN: 第一种重大抗生素，源于霉菌。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the anti- prefix, the bios life root, and the hospital phrases.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子利用前缀 anti-、词根 bios「生命」，以及医院常用语。

normal.en: anti + bio + tic: against (bacterial) life.
normal.cn: anti 加 bio 加 tic：对抗（细菌的）生命。

normal.en: Antibiotics kill bacteria, not viruses.
normal.cn: 抗生素杀细菌，不杀病毒。

normal.en: Biology, antibiotic, symbiosis all share bios, life.
normal.cn: biology、antibiotic、symbiosis 都共享 bios「生命」。

normal.en: Antibiotic resistance is when bacteria learn to survive the drug.
normal.cn: antibiotic resistance 指细菌学会在药物下存活。

normal.en: A course means finishing every pill the doctor gave.
normal.cn: a course 指把医生开的药全部吃完。

abstract.en: Picture a shield stamped with a minus sign pressed against a swarm of dots.
abstract.cn: 想象一面印着减号的盾牌顶住一群点状细菌。

abstract.en: Picture a mold dish where a clear ring stops the spreading dots.
abstract.cn: 想象培养皿中一圈透明地带拦住了扩散的点群。

abstract.en: Picture a tiny doorman refusing entry to bacteria only.
abstract.cn: 想象一个小门卫只拒绝细菌入内。

examples.en: Take the full course of antibiotics even if you feel better.
examples.cn: 即使好转也要服完整个疗程的抗生素。

examples.en: Overuse of antibiotics breeds resistant bacteria.
examples.cn: 滥用抗生素催生耐药菌。

examples.en: The ointment has mild antibiotic action.
examples.cn: 这种药膏有温和的抗菌作用。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「安泰拜奥替」——安泰（安康）靠拜拜奥妙细菌换来，就是「抗生素」

root: 希腊语 anti-（对抗）+ bios（生命）+ -tic（形容词后缀）→ 对抗生命的物质 → 对抗细菌的药物；二十世纪随青霉素普及定型。

sensesIntro.en: From a general life-poison the word narrowed to the bacteria-fighting drug, and gave back an adjective.
sensesIntro.cn: 由泛指的毒害生命之物收窄为抗细菌药物，并回赠一个形容词。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: life turned against life, a poison drawn as a shield
core.cn: 核心意象：以生命制生命，一剂被画成盾牌的「毒药」

branches.en: The pharmacy line: the drug that emptied the fever wards.
branches.cn: 药房线：让发热病房清空的那种药。

branches.en: The material line: coatings and soaps with the same power.
branches.cn: 材料线：拥有同样力量的涂层与皂类。

branches.en: Both stand anti- against bacterial bios.
branches.cn: 两者都以 anti- 对抗细菌的 bios。

branches.en: The narrow line: antibiotics miss viruses entirely.
branches.cn: 界限线：抗生素对病毒完全无效。

branches.en: The resistance line: every use trains the survivors.
branches.cn: 耐药线：每一次使用都在训练幸存菌。

intro.en: The word shows three Greek pieces: anti-, bio-, and -tic.
intro.cn: 这个词含三个希腊成分：anti-、bio- 与 -tic。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin family; the entries record the Greek source words.
latinIntro.cn: 该词没有拉丁词族；条目记录希腊语源头词。

items.example: It supplies the opposition in antibiotic.
items.exampleCN: 它为 antibiotic 提供对抗义。

items.meaning: relating to, having the nature of
items.exampleCN: 它构成 dramatic 与 antibiotic。

items.example: It forms antibody, the body's own weapon.
items.exampleCN: 它构成抗体 antibody，身体的自造武器。

items.example: It forms biology, the study of life.
It shares bios but means cooperation, not war.
items.exampleCN: 它共享 bios，但意为合作而非对抗。

items.example: It forms antidote, given against poison.

definition_en: a protein made by the immune system that recognises and binds to a specific foreign substance
core_image: 一个 Y 形的蛋白分子用两个臂抓住一个病毒表面的突起
scene: 免疫系统记住了那次感染，下次就能立刻认出病毒。The antibody binds to the virus and marks it for destruction.
sceneCN: 这里 antibody 指「抗体」（第 1 个义项：免疫系统产生、能识别并结合特定异物的蛋白）；句意：抗体结合到病毒上，并把它标记为待清除对象。图中可辨识物件：Y 形蛋白分子、病毒颗粒、结合位点、免疫细胞。

pos.zh: 抗体；免疫球蛋白（能识别并结合特定抗原的蛋白）

derivatives.zh: 抗原
自身抗体
免疫球蛋白
抗血清

senses.title: Immune binding protein
senses.titleCN: 抗体：免疫系统产生、能特异结合的蛋白
senses.definition: a protein produced by immune cells that recognises a specific foreign molecule and binds to it
senses.definitionCN: 免疫细胞产生、能识别特定异物分子并与之结合的蛋白质
senses.example: The antibody binds to the virus and marks it for destruction.
senses.exampleCN: 抗体结合到病毒上，并把它标记为待清除对象。
senses.why: The name is a literal translation of German Antikörper, 'against-body': the substance made against the foreign body that entered.
senses.whyCN: 这个名字是德语 Antikörper「对抗外来体」的直译：针对进入体内的异物而造出的物质。

senses.title: A specific antibody
senses.titleCN: 某一种抗体：针对某一抗原的那一个
senses.definition: one particular antibody directed at one antigen, often named after its target
senses.definitionCN: 针对某一抗原的一种抗体，常以其目标命名
senses.example: Doctors looked for antibodies to the measles virus in her blood.
senses.exampleCN: 医生在她的血液中寻找针对麻疹病毒的抗体。
senses.why: Each antibody has a unique binding site, so the general word is constantly used for a single member of the family, named by its target.
senses.whyCN: 每个抗体都有独特的结合位点，因此这个总称常被用来指家族中的一个具体成员，并以目标命名。

senses.title: Neutralizing antibody
senses.titleCN: 中和抗体：结合后使病原失去感染力
senses.definition: an antibody that blocks a virus or toxin from entering cells or doing harm
senses.definitionCN: 结合后阻止病毒或毒素进入细胞或造成伤害的抗体
senses.example: A neutralizing antibody can stop the virus before it enters a cell.
senses.exampleCN: 中和抗体能在病毒进入细胞之前把它拦住。
senses.why: Binding alone is not always enough; some antibodies physically cover the entry site, and that functional result earned its own name.
senses.whyCN: 仅仅结合未必够用；有些抗体物理地遮住进入位点，这一功能结果便获得了专名。

senses.title: Monoclonal antibody
senses.titleCN: 单克隆抗体：来自单一细胞系、结构一致
senses.definition: a laboratory-made antibody produced from one cell line, so that every copy is identical
senses.definitionCN: 由单一细胞系产生的实验室抗体，每一份拷贝都相同
senses.example: The monoclonal antibody is used in both tests and cancer treatment.
senses.exampleCN: 这种单克隆抗体既用于检测，也用于癌症治疗。
senses.why: Natural antibodies are a mixture; cloning one cell line makes a single reagent, and industry needed a term for that uniformity.
senses.whyCN: 天然抗体是混合物；克隆一个细胞系可得到单一试剂，产业需要为这种一致性造一个术语。

senses.title: Polyclonal antibody
senses.titleCN: 多克隆抗体：来自多种细胞、识别多个位点
senses.definition: an antibody preparation containing many different antibodies that recognise different parts of the same target
senses.definitionCN: 含多种抗体、识别同一目标不同部位的抗体制品
senses.example: The polyclonal antibody still works when the virus mutates.
senses.exampleCN: 即使病毒变异，这种多克隆抗体仍然有效。
senses.why: An animal immunised against a whole germ makes many antibodies at once, and that breadth is useful precisely where a single clone would fail.
senses.whyCN: 用整个病原免疫动物会一次产生许多抗体，这种广度恰在单一克隆失效之处有用。

senses.title: Autoantibody
senses.titleCN: 自身抗体：攻击自身组织的抗体
senses.definition: an antibody that recognises the body's own tissue and attacks it, causing autoimmune disease
senses.definitionCN: 识别并攻击自身组织的抗体，引起自身免疫病
senses.example: Autoantibodies against the thyroid explain her fatigue.
senses.exampleCN: 针对甲状腺的自身抗体解释了她的疲乏。
senses.why: The mechanism is the same as against a germ; only the target is wrong, so a prefix rather than a new word marks the pathology.
senses.whyCN: 机制与对抗病原完全相同，只是目标错了，因此用前缀而不是新词来标记这种病理。

senses.title: Antibody titre
senses.titleCN: 抗体滴度：以稀释倍数表示的抗体浓度
senses.definition: the amount of a particular antibody in the blood, usually expressed as the highest dilution that still gives a positive test
senses.definitionCN: 血中某种抗体的量，通常以仍呈阳性结果的最高稀释倍数表示
senses.example: Her antibody titre rose sharply after the second dose.
senses.exampleCN: 第二剂之后她的抗体滴度大幅上升。
senses.why: Because antibodies act by binding, their usefulness is a matter of how much is present, and dilution is the practical way to measure that.
senses.whyCN: 抗体的作用靠结合，因此其有用性取决于存在多少，而稀释是测量这个量的实用方法。

senses.title: Antibody as reagent
senses.titleCN: 抗体试剂：检测中用来抓取目标分子
senses.definition: an antibody used in the laboratory as a tool to detect, label or separate the molecule it binds
senses.definitionCN: 实验室中用来检测、标记或分离其所结合分子的抗体工具
senses.example: The antibody was conjugated to a dye for the pregnancy test.
senses.exampleCN: 这种抗体被接上染料，用于妊娠检测。
senses.why: Specific binding is a targeting mechanism, so the same molecule that defends a body can be used to find a substance on a plastic strip.
senses.whyCN: 特异结合是一种定位机制，因此同一个保卫身体的分子也能被用来在塑料试纸条上找到某种物质。

intro.en: Antibody is an English loan translation of German Antikörper, coined in the age of serum research: anti- 'against' plus body, the foreign body that the substance works against.
intro.cn: antibody 是德语 Antikörper 的英语仿译，造于血清研究时代：anti-「对抗」加 body，即该物质所对抗的外来体。

items.en: Greek anti meant 'against, instead of', and English uses it in hundreds of words for opposition or counteraction.
items.cn: 希腊 anti 意为「对抗、代替」，英语用它造出大量表示对抗或反作用的词。

items.en: In the 1890s researchers found that blood serum could neutralise toxins and bacteria, and that the effect could be transferred from one animal to another.
items.cn: 1890 年代研究者发现血清能中和毒素与细菌，而且这种效应可从一只动物转移到另一只。

items.en: Paul Ehrlich and others described the active substances as substances formed against a foreign body, and German named them Antikörper.
items.cn: 保罗·埃利希等人把这些活性物质描述为针对外来体而形成的物质，德语称之为 Antikörper。

items.en: English rendered the German compound piece by piece as antibody, first in the 1890s, keeping the literal structure of the original.
items.cn: 英语把德语复合词逐部件译成 antibody，最早见于 1890 年代，保留了原词的字面结构。

items.en: When the chemistry of these proteins was worked out in the twentieth century, the neutral term immunoglobulin was added, and the two words now name the same class from different angles.
items.cn: 20 世纪弄清这些蛋白的化学结构后，又加入了中性的 immunoglobulin 一词；今天两个词从不同角度命名同一类分子。

items.en: Source uncertainty: the exact English first date and the precise share of credit between Ehrlich and his contemporaries are not firmly fixed; the 1891 attribution usually given is approximate.
items.cn: 来源不确定（仅首见年代与归属存疑）：antibody 的英语确切首见年代、以及埃利希与同代人之间应得的贡献比例都无定论；通常所说的 1891 年只是约数。

note.en: The first group holds the partner terms and look-alikes built from anti-; the second holds the immune proteins and preparations that are easily mistaken for an antibody.
note.cn: 第一组是配对术语与用 anti- 构成的形近词；第二组是容易与抗体混淆的免疫蛋白与制品。

entries.definition: The foreign substance that an antibody binds; antigen ends in -gen 'producing', antibody ends in body.
entries.definitionCN: 抗体所结合的异物；antigen 以 -gen「产生」结尾，antibody 以 body 结尾。

entries.definition: A drug that kills bacteria, from anti- plus Greek bios 'life'; it acts on the germ, not on the immune system.
entries.definitionCN: 杀灭细菌的药物，来自 anti- 加希腊 bios「生命」；它作用于病原而非免疫系统。

entries.definition: Blood serum containing antibodies, used as a treatment; it is a container of antibodies, not one antibody.
entries.definitionCN: 含抗体的血清制品，用作治疗；它是抗体的容器，而不是单个抗体。

entries.definition: The protein class to which antibodies belong; the two words overlap almost completely but differ in register.
entries.definitionCN: 抗体所属的蛋白类别；两个词几乎完全重叠，只是语体不同。

entries.definition: The protection itself; antibodies are one of the means by which immunity is achieved.
entries.definitionCN: 指保护状态本身；抗体是实现免疫的手段之一。

entries.definition: A preparation that trains the body to make antibodies; it contains antigens rather than antibodies.
entries.definitionCN: 训练身体产生抗体的制品；它含的是抗原而不是抗体。

entries.definition: A white blood cell that kills infected cells directly; it acts by contact rather than by secreted binding proteins.
entries.definitionCN: 直接杀死受感染细胞的白细胞；它靠接触而非分泌结合蛋白发挥作用。

entries.definition: A molecule on a cell surface that binds a specific substance; it shares the binding function but is not made against a germ.
entries.definitionCN: 细胞表面结合特定物质的分子；共享结合功能，但不是针对病原而造。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real collocations and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: anti- 'against' + body 'foreign body' gives 'the thing made against the invader'.
normal.cn: anti-「对抗」+ body「外来体」得出「针对入侵者造出的东西」。

normal.en: The pair is fixed: antigen is the target, antibody is the defender.
normal.cn: 这一对是固定的：antigen 是目标，antibody 是防御者。

normal.en: The family runs antibody, antigen, antiserum, autoantibody and immunoglobulin.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 antibody、antigen、antiserum、autoantibody、immunoglobulin。

normal.en: Y-shaped with two arms: each arm is one binding site, which is why one antibody can grip two targets.
normal.cn: Y 形有两个臂，每个臂一个结合位点，因此一个抗体能抓住两个目标。

normal.en: monoclonal means one clone, polyclonal means many clones.
normal.cn: monoclonal 指单一克隆，polyclonal 指多克隆。

abstract.en: Picture a molecular hand that fits one lock and no other.
abstract.cn: 想象一只分子之手，只配一把锁，别的一概不配。

abstract.en: Picture a tag attached to an intruder so the guards can see it.
abstract.cn: 想象一张标签贴到入侵者身上，让守卫看得见。

abstract.en: Picture a factory line where every copy of one tool is identical.
abstract.cn: 想象一条生产线，同一件工具的每一份都一模一样。

examples.en: Antibodies appear in the blood a week or two after infection.
examples.cn: 感染后一两周，血液中会出现抗体。

examples.en: Monoclonal antibodies are grown in tanks rather than taken from people.
examples.cn: 单克隆抗体在罐中培养，而不是从人体中提取。

examples.en: The antibody test shows past exposure, not current infection.
examples.cn: 抗体检测显示的是既往接触，而不是当前感染。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「anti 对抗 + body 身体（外来体）」——针对外来体造出的蛋白 → antibody 抗体

root: 希腊 anti「对抗」+ 英语 body「体」→ 仿译德语 Antikörper → 英语 antibody（1890 年代）。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one Y-shaped grip: the class of binding proteins, one member of it, the neutralizing and monoclonal and polyclonal forms, the misdirected autoantibody, its measured amount, and its use as a lab reagent.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿一个 Y 形抓握展开：这一类结合蛋白、其中一个成员、中和型与单克隆型及多克隆型、瞄错目标的自身抗体、它的测定量，以及它作为实验室试剂的用途。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a Y-shaped protein whose two arms lock onto a germ's surface.
core.cn: 核心意象：一个 Y 形蛋白，两个臂锁住病原表面。

branches.en: CLASS AND MEMBER: the whole family of binding proteins, then a single named one.
branches.cn: 类别与成员：整个结合蛋白家族，然后是单个有名字的成员。

branches.en: FUNCTION AND MANUFACTURE: some antibodies block entry, others are grown as identical reagents.
branches.cn: 功能与制造：有些抗体封住入口，有些则被培养成一致的试剂。

branches.en: BREADTH: a polyclonal mixture covers many sites where one clone cannot.
branches.cn: 广度：多克隆混合物覆盖单一克隆覆盖不了的多个位点。

branches.en: WRONG TARGET AND NUMBER: against the self it causes disease, and its amount is measured by dilution.
branches.cn: 错误目标与数量：针对自身时致病，其多少用稀释测定。

branches.en: OUT OF THE BODY: specific binding becomes a detection tool on a test strip.

intro.en: Antibody is a two-word compound fused into one: anti- 'against' plus body. Its relatives are built by adding prefixes such as auto- and mono-.

senses.title: To expect in advance
senses.definition: to think that something will probably happen and be ready for it
senses.definitionCN: 认为某事很可能会发生，并为此作好准备
senses.example: We anticipate strong resistance to the plan.
senses.exampleCN: 我们预料这个计划会遇到强烈反对。
senses.why: Latin anticipare joined ante, 'before', to capere, 'take', so the word literally means taking something before it arrives; expecting is that mental pre-taking.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 anticipare 把 ante「在前」与 capere「拿取」合在一起，字面就是「在事情到达之前先拿住」，预料正是这种在心里的预先拿取。

senses.title: To look forward to
senses.definition: to await something with pleasure or eagerness
senses.definitionCN: 带着愉快或急切的心情等待某事
senses.example: The children anticipate the trip with excitement.
senses.exampleCN: 孩子们兴奋地期盼着这次旅行。
senses.why: If you have already taken the future event into your mind, you can begin enjoying it now, and that pleasure turns expectation into looking forward.
senses.whyCN: 如果未来的事已经被你提前拿进心里，你现在就能开始享受它，这种愉悦使「预料」变成了「期盼」。

senses.title: To act before someone
senses.definition: to do something before another person can do it
senses.definitionCN: 在别人能行动之前先做
senses.example: They anticipated their rivals by launching the product a month early.
senses.exampleCN: 他们比对手抢先一个月推出产品。
senses.why: Taking before also works in time, not only in thought: to anticipate a rival is to occupy the position first.
senses.whyCN: 「先拿」不仅发生在思想里，也发生在时间上：anticipate 对手就是把位置先占住。

senses.title: Taking beforehand: getting something into your hands early
senses.titleCN: 先取：提前把东西拿到手
senses.definition: the act of taking possession of or taking up something before the expected time
senses.definitionCN: 在预期时间之前先占有或取用某物
senses.example: Their anticipation of the best seats left the latecomers standing.
senses.exampleCN: 他们抢先占下了最好的座位，迟到的人只好站着。
senses.why: Latin anticipatio renders anticipare, literally 'taking into possession beforehand' (anti- 'before' + capere 'to take'). The noun names the completed act of getting there first.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 anticipatio 对应 anticipare，字面是“提前拿进占有”（anti-“在前”+ capere“拿取”）。这个名词命名的就是“抢先到手”这一完成的动作。

senses.title: Preparing ahead: taking care of something in advance
senses.titleCN: 预先安排：提前把事办妥
senses.definition: the act of arranging for or attending to something before it is needed
senses.definitionCN: 在某事需要之前就安排或照料好它
senses.example: The preparation of the accounts in anticipation of the audit saved the company a week.
senses.exampleCN: 为审计提前整理账目，为公司省下了一周时间。
senses.why: Once 'taking' is applied to duties rather than objects, what is taken is care. Latin anticipare could mean 'take care of ahead of time', so the noun moves from possession to prior arrangement.
senses.whyCN: 当“拿取”的对象从物件变成责任，被拿到的就是“照料”。拉丁语 anticipare 可表“提前照料”，于是名词从“占有”转向“预先安排”。

senses.title: Forestalling: acting before something can happen
senses.titleCN: 先发制人：抢在事情发生之前动手
senses.definition: the act of preventing or pre-empting an event by acting first
senses.definitionCN: 通过抢先行动来阻止或预先化解某件事
senses.example: The troops moved in anticipation of the attack and seized the ridge first.
senses.exampleCN: 部队为防敌军进攻而先发制人，抢先占领了山脊。
senses.why: If you take the ground before the other side arrives, the event cannot unfold as planned. Around 1600 the noun acquired this sense of pre-emption, still alive in military and medical 'in anticipation of'.
senses.whyCN: 若在对方到达前先占住地面，事情就无法按原计划展开。约 1600 年，这个词获得了“先发制人”的含义，至今仍活在军事和医学的 in anticipation of 中。

senses.title: Foreknowledge: knowing before it happens
senses.titleCN: 预知：事情发生前先知道
senses.definition: knowledge of an event before it occurs
senses.definitionCN: 在某事件发生之前就掌握关于它的知识
senses.example: Her anticipation of the market crash came from reading the same data everyone else ignored.
senses.exampleCN: 她对市场崩盘的预知，来自阅读那些被别人忽略的同一批数据。
senses.why: In the 1640s the word moved from acting ahead to knowing ahead: the mind takes the future into itself before the event arrives. The underlying gesture is still capere, to grasp.
senses.whyCN: 17 世纪 40 年代，这个词从“提前行动”移到“提前知道”：心智在事件到来之前先把未来抓进来。底层动作仍是 capere“抓取”。

senses.title: Expectation: awaiting something with hope or fear
senses.titleCN: 期待：怀着希望或不安等待
senses.definition: the state of expecting something to happen, especially with pleasure or anxiety
senses.definitionCN: 预期某事将会发生的心态，尤带喜悦或焦虑
senses.example: The children's anticipation grew as the first snow clouds appeared.
senses.exampleCN: 初雪的云一出现，孩子们的期待就更浓了。
senses.why: The 'expectation' sense appears in 1749. It keeps the 'before' of the root but drops active preparation, leaving the mind already holding the future. Etymologically it is not the same as expect, which looks outward (ex- + spectare).
senses.whyCN: “期待”义出现于 1749 年。它保留了词根的“在前”，却丢掉了主动准备，只剩下心智提前握有未来。词源上它并不等于 expect——后者是“向外看”（ex- + spectare）。

senses.title: A foretaste: an advance hint of what is coming
senses.titleCN: 预尝：先尝到未来的一小口
senses.definition: a partial experience or preview of something before the full event
senses.definitionCN: 在完整事件到来之前，对它的部分体验或预先领略
senses.example: The first chapter is an anticipation of the themes developed later.
senses.exampleCN: 第一章是对后文展开的主题的一次预尝。
senses.why: The noun can name the thing taken early as well as the act: a small portion of the future is sampled in advance, like a foretaste of a meal.
senses.whyCN: 这个名词既能指“提前拿取的动作”，也能指“被提前拿到的东西”：未来的一小部分被预先品尝，就像饭前的一口试味。

senses.title: Early payment: discharging a debt before it is due
senses.titleCN: 提前偿付：在到期前还清款项
senses.definition: the payment of money before the due date, often at a discount
senses.definitionCN: 在到期日之前付款，常因此获得折扣
senses.example: The invoice offered a 2 percent discount for anticipation of payment.
senses.exampleCN: 发票给出提前付款可享 2% 的折扣。
senses.why: In commerce, 'taking before' becomes paying before: the debtor takes the due date out of the future. This is a narrow technical branch of the same 'beforehand' idea.
senses.whyCN: 在商业里，“提前拿取”变成“提前支付”：债务人把到期日从未来挪走。这是同一个“在前”观念下的一条狭窄技术分支。

senses.title: Music: a note sounded before its harmony arrives
senses.titleCN: 音乐中的提前音：比和声早到一拍
senses.definition: in harmony and counterpoint, a tone that enters one beat before the chord it belongs to
senses.definitionCN: 在和声与对位中，比它所属和弦早一拍进入的音
senses.example: The violin's anticipation slips in a beat before the downbeat chord.
senses.exampleCN: 小提琴的提前音在和弦落下前的一拍滑了进来。
senses.why: Here the 'before' is measured in beats. The note is taken up early and held until the harmony catches up, so the musical term is a literal local use of the core image.
senses.whyCN: 这里的“在前”以拍子计量。音被提前拿起来，一直保持到和声赶上，因此这个音乐术语是核心意象的一次字面化局部使用。

senses.title: Rhetoric: answering an objection before it is raised
senses.titleCN: 修辞中的预辩：抢在质疑之前先答
senses.definition: the rhetorical figure of raising and answering a possible objection in advance (prolepsis)
senses.definitionCN: 提前提出并回答可能出现的反对意见的修辞手法（预辩法）
senses.example: The essay's anticipation of the counterargument made the conclusion harder to resist.
senses.exampleCN: 这篇文章预先答驳了相反论点，使结论更难被抗拒。
senses.why: In rhetoric the speaker takes the opponent's point into the argument first, disarming it before it is spoken. The Latin noun was already used for this figure, so the branch is ancient rather than modern.
senses.whyCN: 在修辞中，说话者先把对方的论点拿进自己的论证里，在它被说出口之前就卸掉它的力。拉丁语名词早已用于这一辞格，所以这条分支很古老，并非现代新义。

intro.en: Anticipation is a Latin action noun that reached English through French; the verb anticipate was probably back-formed from it, though it may also come directly from Latin anticipatus. Dates are approximate, and the noun is older in English than the verb.
intro.cn: anticipation 是经法语进入英语的拉丁语动作名词；动词 anticipate 一般认为由它逆构，也可能直接取自拉丁语 anticipatus，这一步来源不确定。年代为大致估计；在英语里名词比动词更早。

items.en: The sense 'expectation' is recorded. It is the newest layer and must not be read back into the older senses.
items.cn: “期待”义见于记载。这是最新的一层，不能反向套到更早的义项上。

items.en: The sense 'foreknowledge, knowing beforehand' appears, moving the word from action to knowledge.
items.cn: “预知、提前知道”义出现，这个词从行动转向知识。

items.en: The sense 'prevention, forestalling' is recorded, from acting before an event can take its course.
items.cn: “预防、先发制人”义见于记载，来自抢在事件展开之前行动。

items.en: The verb anticipate is recorded, either back-formed from the noun anticipation or taken from Latin anticipatus, the past participle of anticipare.
items.cn: 动词 anticipate 见于记载，或由名词 anticipation 逆构，或直接取自拉丁语 anticipatus——anticipare 的过去分词。

items.en: Latin anticipatio is the action noun of anticipare 'take (care of) ahead of time', literally 'taking into possession beforehand'. The English suffix -ion comes from Latin -ionem, which names an action or its result.
items.cn: 拉丁语 anticipatio 是 anticipare“提前（照料）”的动作名词，字面为“提前拿进占有”。英语后缀 -ion 来自拉丁语 -ionem，表示动作或其结果。

items.en: anticipare joins anti-, an old form of ante 'before' (from PIE *ant- 'front, forehead'), with capere 'to take' (from PIE *kap- 'to grasp'). The 'before' is spatial first, then temporal.
items.cn: anticipare 由 anti-（ante“在前”的古形，出自原始印欧语 *ant-“前面、额头”）加 capere“拿取”（出自 PIE *kap-“抓握”）构成。“在前”先是空间义，后转为时间义。

note.en: The first group separates accidental spelling neighbours from the real family; the second group compares words that share part of the meaning.
note.cn: 第一组把偶然撞形的词与真正的同族词分开；第二组比较只共享部分含义的词。

entries.definition: the ancient past, or an object from it. It begins with anti- by accident; its root is antiquus 'old', not ante 'before'.
entries.definitionCN: 古代；古物。它只是碰巧以 anti- 开头，词根是 antiquus“古老的”，不是 ante“在前”。

entries.definition: a strong dislike. The anti- here is Greek anti 'against', and the second element is pathos 'feeling', not capere.
entries.definitionCN: 强烈的反感。这里的 anti- 是希腊语 anti“反对”，第二部分是 pathos“情感”，与 capere 无关。

entries.definition: the verb recorded in the 1530s, back-formed from anticipation or taken from Latin anticipatus. In English the noun came first.
entries.definitionCN: 1530 年代记录的动词，由 anticipation 逆构或取自拉丁语 anticipatus。在英语里名词先出现。

entries.definition: the belief that something will happen. It stresses the waiting mind, while anticipation often adds prior preparation.
entries.definitionCN: 认为某事会发生的信念。它强调等待的心态，而 anticipation 常另含提前准备。

entries.definition: careful thinking about what will happen before acting. It stresses deliberate planning, where anticipation may be mere foreknowledge.
entries.definitionCN: 行动前对将发生之事的仔细考虑。它强调有意的筹划，而 anticipation 可能只是预知。

entries.definition: the act of acting before another can, especially to block them. It is the legal and military edge of anticipation's forestalling sense.
entries.definitionCN: 抢在别人之前行动，尤指使其无法行动。它是 anticipation“先发制人”义在法律和军事上的锐化版。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the real parts of the word and its real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想只使用这个词真实的构成成分和真实同族词，不用编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: anticipate is a back-formation from anticipation, so in English the noun is older than the verb.
normal.cn: anticipate 是由 anticipation 逆构的，所以在英语里名词比动词年长。

normal.en: The anti- in anticipation is not 'against' but an old form of ante 'before', the same 'before' in ante meridiem (a.m.).
normal.cn: anticipation 里的 anti- 不是“反对”，而是 ante“在前”的古形，和 ante meridiem（a.m. 上午）里的“在前”相同。

normal.en: capere 'to take' also gives capture, capable and capacity: anticipation is literally 'taking first'.
normal.cn: capere“拿取”还给出 capture、capable、capacity：anticipation 字面上就是“先拿”。

normal.en: In anticipation of is the everyday phrase: it means 'before, and in preparation for'.
normal.cn: in anticipation of 是日常短语，意思是“在……之前，并为……做准备”。

normal.en: Expectation is only the newest layer (1749); beneath it lie possession, prevention and foreknowledge.
normal.cn: “期待”只是最新的一层（1749）；它下面还压着占有、预防和预知。

abstract.en: Picture a hand reaching across a table and pulling an object toward itself before anyone else moves.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手越过桌面，在别人动手之前先把东西拢向自己。

abstract.en: The same hand can take a duty, take ground before an enemy, take the future into the mind, or take a note into the bar early.
abstract.cn: 同一只手可以接下责任、抢在敌人前占住地面、把未来拿进心里，或把一个音符提前放进小节。

abstract.en: All nine senses keep the prefix 'before' and vary only what is taken: goods, care, ground, knowledge, a foretaste, money, a beat, an argument.
abstract.cn: 九个义项都保留“在前”，变化的只是被拿取的东西：货物、照料、地面、知识、预尝、金钱、拍子、论点。

examples.en: Scientists collected data in anticipation of the drought.
examples.cn: 科学家们为防备干旱而提前收集了数据。

examples.en: The audience waited in anticipation as the curtain rose.
examples.cn: 幕布升起时，观众满怀期待地等待着。

examples.en: The law's anticipation of fraud made the contract void from the start.
examples.cn: 法律对欺诈的预先防范使这份合同自始无效。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「俺替谁赔身」——俺替谁赔这身衣裳？事先就料到要赔，早做了准备 → anticipation 预料、预先准备

root: 拉丁语 anticipare“提前取得、提前照料”＝anti-（ante“在前”的古形）+ capere“拿取”；anticipation 经拉丁动作名词 anticipatio 与法语进入英语，核心是“抢先拿到手、提前处理”。

sensesIntro.en: Nine senses of anticipation all keep one prefix: something is taken before its time. What is taken changes — goods, care, ground, knowledge, a foretaste, money, a musical beat, an opponent's argument.
sensesIntro.cn: anticipation 的九个义项都保留同一个“在前”：某物在它的时间之前被拿取。变化的只是被拿的东西——货物、照料、地面、知识、预尝、金钱、音乐拍子、对方的论点。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a hand takes an object before anyone else reaches it.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只手赶在别人伸手之前把东西拿走。

branches.en: POSSESSION AND CARE: first the goods are taken early, then the duty is taken care of early.
branches.cn: 占有与照料：先提前拿到货物，再提前把责任办妥。

branches.en: FORESTALLING: taking the ground first prevents the event from taking its course.
branches.cn: 先发制人：先占住地面，使事件无法按原样展开。

branches.en: KNOWING AHEAD: the mind grasps the future, and a small part of it can be tasted in advance.
branches.cn: 提前知道：心智抓住未来，而未来的一小部分可以提前品尝。

branches.en: EXPECTATION: the active preparation fades, leaving the mind holding what has not yet arrived.
branches.cn: 期待：主动准备淡去，只剩心智握有尚未到来之物。

branches.en: FORMAL EARLY ARRIVALS: money paid before the due date, a note before its chord, an answer before the objection.
branches.cn: 形式化的提前到达：到期前付的钱、和弦前的音、质疑前的回答。

intro.en: Anticipation is Latin anticipat- plus -ion. The suffix -ion, from Latin -ionem, turns an action verb into the name of the action or its result; English then builds the verb and adjectives around this noun.
intro.cn: anticipation 是拉丁词干 anticipat- 加 -ion。后缀 -ion 出自拉丁语 -ionem，把动作动词变成“动作或其结果”的名称；英语随后围绕这个名词构造动词和形容词。

latinIntro.en: The two Latin pieces are ante/anti- 'before' and capere 'to take, grasp'. capere supplies the stems capt- and cip-, visible in capture, captive, accept and participate.
latinIntro.cn: 两个拉丁成分是 ante/anti-“在前”和 capere“拿取、抓握”。capere 提供 capt- 与 cip- 词干，见于 capture、captive、accept、participate。

items.meaning: the act of taking or knowing in advance, or its result
items.meaningCN: 提前拿取或预知的行为，及其结果（-ion 构成动作／结果名词）
items.example: The announcement was met with anticipation rather than alarm.
items.exampleCN: 这项公告引来的是期待，而非惊慌。

items.meaning: to expect, foresee, or deal with in advance
items.example: We anticipate a rise in demand next quarter.
items.exampleCN: 我们预计下季度需求会上升。

items.meaning: done in preparation for something expected
items.meaningCN: 为预期之事做准备的；预支的（-ory 构成形容词）
items.example: The bank imposed an anticipatory penalty on early repayment.
items.exampleCN: 银行对提前还款收取预先设定的罚金。

items.meaning: tending to expect or act in advance
items.meaningCN: 倾向于预期或提前行动的（-ive 构成形容词）
items.example: Her anticipative habits kept the team supplied.
items.exampleCN: 她凡事提前准备的习惯让团队物资不断。

items.meaningCN: 未预料到的；未考虑到的（un- 否定 + -ed 形容词）
items.example: An unanticipated delay doubled the cost.
items.exampleCN: 一场未预料到的延误使成本翻倍。

items.meaning: a person who expects or acts beforehand
items.meaningCN: 预想者；提前行动的人（-or 表示施动者）
items.example: The early buyer was an anticipator of the shortage.
items.exampleCN: 那位早早买入的人预见了短缺。

items.meaning: able to hold or take in; having the power to do
items.meaningCN: 有能力的；能容纳的（cap-“拿、容纳”+ -able）
items.example: The tank is capable of holding ten thousand litres.

items.meaning: the power to hold, receive, or do
items.meaningCN: 容量；能力（-ity 构成性质／状态名词）
items.example: The hall has a capacity of eight hundred people.
items.exampleCN: 这个大厅可容纳八百人。

items.meaning: the act of catching and holding something
items.meaningCN: 捕获；俘获（-ure 构成动作／结果名词）
items.example: The capture of the escaped horse took three hours.
items.exampleCN: 花了三个小时才抓住那匹逃跑的马。

items.meaning: to take something offered to oneself
items.meaningCN: 接受（字面“拿向自己”）；承认
items.example: She accepted the invitation without hesitation.
items.exampleCN: 她毫不犹豫地接受了邀请。

latinEntries.meaning: to take beforehand, take care of ahead of time
a taking beforehand; the action noun behind anticipation
latinEntries.meaningCN: 提前拿取；anticipation 所本的拉丁动作名词

definition_en: a weather system with high pressure at its center, where winds spiral outward and skies stay calm
core_image: 一锅缓慢向外旋开的漩涡，中心晴朗无云
scene: 连日的雨停了，预报图上一个巨大的圆盘正缓缓盖上这座城市。A summer anticyclone brought a week of clear, windless skies.
sceneCN: 这里 anticyclone 是「反气旋」（第 1 个义项：中心高压、气流向外的天气系统）；句意为夏季反气旋带来一周晴朗无风的天气。

derivatives.zh: 由本词加 -ic 构成，义为「反气旋的」
同族基础词，义为「气旋；低压系统」

senses.title: A high-pressure weather system
senses.definition: an area of high atmospheric pressure around which winds circulate outward, bringing settled weather
senses.definitionCN: 高气压区，风绕其中心向外旋转，带来稳定天气
senses.example: Fog formed overnight under the anticyclone.
senses.exampleCN: 反气旋控制下，夜间起了雾。
senses.why: The winds run opposite to a cyclone, so the prefix anti- 'against' was attached to cyclone 'wheel'.
senses.whyCN: 风向与气旋相反，所以在 cyclone「轮转」前加上 anti-「反向」前缀。

senses.title: Opposing a cyclone in direction of spin
senses.definition: describing winds or rotation running opposite to the direction of a cyclone in the same hemisphere
senses.definitionCN: 描述在同一半球内与气旋旋转方向相反的风或环流
senses.example: The ocean eddy shows anticyclonic rotation, the reverse of the storm's spin.
senses.exampleCN: 这个海洋涡旋呈反气旋式旋转，与风暴的转向相反。
senses.why: The same anti- 'opposite' applies not to weather quality but to the wheel's direction itself.
senses.whyCN: 同一个 anti-「反向」在此不指天气性质，而指风轮本身的转向。

intro.en: Anticyclone is anti- 'against' plus cyclone, from Greek kyklon, a noun from kyklos 'wheel, circle'.
intro.cn: anticyclone 由 anti-「反向」加 cyclone 构成，后者源自希腊语 kyklos「轮、圆」。

items.en: The root *kwekwlos meant 'wheel', a reduplicated form still visible in cycle and wheel.
items.cn: 词根 *kwekwlos 意为「轮」，是叠音形式，仍见于 cycle 与 wheel。

items.en: Kyklos meant 'circle, wheel', giving cycle, bicycle, and encyclopedia.
items.cn: kyklos 意为「圆、轮」，生出 cycle、bicycle、encyclopedia。

items.en: Kyklon named a whirling storm, a wheel of wind.
items.cn: kyklon 指旋转的风暴，一座风之轮。

items.en: Once cyclone named the inward-spiraling storm, meteorologists coined anticyclone for its opposite twin.
items.cn: cyclone 定名内旋风暴后，气象学家为其孪生反面造出 anticyclone。

items.en: In the northern hemisphere anticyclone winds turn clockwise; in the southern, counterclockwise.
items.cn: 北半球反气旋风顺时针转；南半球逆时针转。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers the wheel family and anti- weather words; the near-meaning group gathers calm-weather terms.
note.cn: 形近组收「轮」词族与 anti- 气象词；近义组收晴稳天气用语。

entries.definition: The low-pressure twin: winds spiral inward, weather turns stormy.
entries.definitionCN: 低压孪生词：风向内旋，天气转 stormy。

entries.definition: An upward fold in rock layers; looks alike, but the root is geology, not wind.
entries.definitionCN: 背斜，岩层上拱；拼形相近，但属地质而非气象。

entries.definition: All-round education; shares kyklos 'circle' in a bookish way.
entries.definitionCN: 百科全书；以书面方式共享 kyklos「圆」。

entries.definition: A high-pressure area on the weather map, marked H.
entries.definitionCN: 天气图上标注 H 的高压区。

entries.definition: An elongated area of high pressure between two lows.
entries.definitionCN: 两个低压之间的高压脊。

entries.definition: Any system that brings calm, settled conditions.
entries.definitionCN: 泛指带来晴稳天气的系统。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the anti- reversal, the cyclone wheel, and the weather-map picture.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子利用 anti- 的反向、cyclone 的风轮，以及天气图画面。

normal.en: anti + cyclone: the wheel that turns the opposite way.
normal.cn: anti 加 cyclone：转向相反的风轮。

normal.en: Cyclone spins inward with storms; anticyclone outward with calm.
normal.cn: 气旋内旋带来风暴；反气旋外旋带来平静。

normal.en: On the map, find the letter H: that is the anticyclone.
normal.cn: 在天气图上找字母 H：那就是反气旋。

normal.en: Bicycle shares the wheel root: two wheels.
normal.cn: bicycle 共享「轮」词根：两个轮子。

normal.en: Anticyclonic is its adjective, as in anticyclonic gloom.
normal.cn: 形容词是 anticyclonic，如 anticyclonic gloom。

abstract.en: Picture a giant silent pinwheel turning outward over a quiet city.
abstract.cn: 想象一座巨大无声的风车在城市上空向外旋转。

abstract.en: Picture a week of flat gray fog under an unmoving sky.
abstract.cn: 想象停滞的天空下连日的灰色平雾。

abstract.en: Picture two spinning tops, one blowing outward, one sucking inward.
abstract.cn: 想象两枚旋转的陀螺，一个向外吹，一个向内吸。

examples.en: The anticyclone stalled, so the smog could not disperse.
examples.cn: 反气旋停滞，烟雾无法散去。

examples.en: Autumn anticyclones give crisp, cloudless days.
examples.cn: 秋季反气旋带来干爽无云的日子。

examples.en: Sailors read the anticyclone as a promise of light winds.
examples.cn: 水手把反气旋读作微风将至的许诺。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「安台赛克隆」——安稳的天气台风被赛着克隆成了平静版，就是「反气旋」

root: 希腊语 anti-（反向）+ kyklon（旋转的风暴，出自 kyklos「轮」）→ 反气旋；与气旋相反的高压外旋系统。

sensesIntro.en: One sense names the high-pressure system; the other reads the same anti- as a plain reversal of spin.
sensesIntro.cn: 第一义项命名高压系统；第二义项把同一个 anti- 读作转向的单纯反转。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a slowly outward-turning wheel of air with clear skies pinned at its hub
core.cn: 核心意象：缓缓外旋的空气之轮，轮毂上钉着一片晴空

branches.en: The calm line: settled skies under a high.
branches.cn: 平静线：高压之下天空安稳。

branches.en: The haze line: the same stillness can trap smog.
branches.cn: 霾线：同样的静稳也会困住烟雾。

branches.en: The mirror line: anticyclone exists against its storm twin.
branches.cn: 镜像线：反气旋与风暴孪生词相对而立。

branches.en: The map line: the letter H names it in every forecast.
branches.cn: 地图线：每张天气图都用字母 H 标出它。

branches.en: Both senses share one reversed wheel, of weather or of water.
branches.cn: 两个义项共享同一个反转的风轮，或在天空，或在海洋。

intro.en: The compound shows anti- attached to cyclone, a Greek wheel-storm.
intro.cn: 这个复合词是把 anti- 加在希腊语的「风轮」cyclone 上。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin family; the entries record the Greek source.
latinIntro.cn: 该词没有拉丁词族；条目记录希腊语源头。

items.example: It supplies the reversal in anticyclone.
items.exampleCN: 它为 anticyclone 提供反向义。

items.example: It appears in cycle, bicycle, cyclone.

items.exampleCN: 它由 kyklos 构成 cyclone。

items.meaning: a whirling storm of low pressure
items.example: It is the stem the prefix attaches to.

items.meaning: a tropical cyclone in the Atlantic
items.example: It names the same wind wheel in a different ocean.
items.exampleCN: 它指另一片海洋的同一座风轮。

items.meaning: a tropical cyclone in the western Pacific
items.example: It is the Pacific name for the wheel of wind.
items.exampleCN: 它是风之轮在太平洋的名字。

definition_zh: 解毒剂；解药；消除负面影响的事物
definition_en: a medicine that counteracts a poison, or anything that offsets an unpleasant effect
core_image: 一杯清泉倒进中了毒的水缸，毒被中和
scene: 急救箱打开，护士按说明取出小瓶。The doctor gave the boy an antidote after he swallowed the berries.
sceneCN: 这里 antidote 是「解毒剂」（第 1 个义项：对抗毒物的药物）；句意为男孩误食浆果后，医生给他用了解毒剂。

derivatives.zh: 由本词加 -al 构成，义为「解毒的」
由形容词加 -ly 构成，义为「作为解毒剂地」

senses.title: A remedy against poison
senses.definition: a substance given to counteract the effects of a poison or venom
senses.definitionCN: 用于对抗毒物或毒液效果的物质
senses.example: Snake venom has a specific antidote in most hospitals now.
senses.exampleCN: 如今多数医院都备有蛇毒的特异性解毒剂。
senses.why: Greek antidoton means 'given against': the remedy is literally handed over to stand against the poison.
senses.whyCN: 希腊语 antidoton 意为「被给予以对抗之物」：解药就是被递到手上、用来抗毒的东西。

senses.title: Anything that offsets a bad feeling or condition
senses.titleCN: 解药；消除负面影响的办法
senses.definition: something that corrects or removes an unpleasant state, such as boredom or despair
senses.definitionCN: 能纠正或消除不快状态的东西，如无聊或沮丧
senses.example: Laughter is the best antidote to a long winter.
senses.exampleCN: 笑声是漫长冬日最好的解药。
senses.why: If poison can be a mood, the 'given against' can be a joke, a walk, or a friend.
senses.whyCN: 毒既可以是情绪，那么「对抗之物」就可以是一个玩笑、一次散步或一位朋友。

intro.en: Antidote comes from Greek antidoton, 'given against', from anti- 'against' and didonai 'to give'.
intro.cn: antidote 来自希腊语 antidoton「被给予以对抗之物」，由 anti-「对抗」与 didonai「给予」构成。

items.en: The root *deh3- meant 'to give', also visible in donate, dose, and date.
items.cn: 词根 *deh3- 意为「给」，同样见于 donate、dose、date。

items.en: Didonai was the ordinary Greek verb 'to give'.
items.cn: didonai 是希腊语「给」的常用动词。

items.en: Antidoton meant 'a remedy given against' a poison or a wound.
items.cn: antidoton 意为「针对毒物或创伤被给予的药」。

items.en: Latin borrowed it as antidotum, keeping the medical sense.
items.cn: 拉丁语借作 antidotum，保留医学义。

items.en: English took it in the fifteenth century, and by the seventeenth it could mean a cure for feelings too.
items.cn: 英语于十五世纪借入；到十七世纪，它也可以解「心情之毒」了。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers anti- words and the give-root family; the near-meaning group gathers remedies.
note.cn: 形近组收 anti- 词与「给」词根家族；近义组收各种解药。

entries.definition: The body's own weapon against invaders; made inside you, not swallowed.
entries.definitionCN: 身体自造的抗入侵武器；生于体内而非服下。

entries.definition: An amount of medicine given; the give-root visible.
entries.definitionCN: 药剂的一次量；「给」词根可见。

entries.definition: Anecdote is a short story; the words look alike but the roots differ.
entries.definitionCN: anecdote 是轶事；两词拼形相近但词根不同。

entries.definition: Serum against a specific venom, the modern antidote for snakebite.
entries.definitionCN: 抗蛇毒血清，蛇咬伤的现代解毒剂。

entries.definition: Any cure for an illness or a problem.
entries.definitionCN: 泛指治疗疾病或解决问题的办法。

entries.definition: An action taken to cancel out an opposing action.
entries.definitionCN: 为抵消对方行动而采取的措施。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use anti- 'against' and the dose 'give' root, plus the anecdote trap.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子利用 anti-「对抗」与 dose「给」词根，以及 anecdote 陷阱。

normal.en: anti + dote: given against the poison.
normal.cn: anti 加 dote：被给予以对抗毒物。

normal.en: Dose shares the give-root: something given.
normal.cn: dose 共享「给」词根：被给予之物。

normal.en: Anecdote is a story, antidote is a cure: one letter apart.
normal.cn: anecdote 是故事，antidote 是解药：只差一个字母。

normal.en: Figuratively, humor is an antidote to fear.
normal.cn: 比喻用法：幽默是恐惧的解药。

normal.en: Donate shares the give-root too: to give a gift.
normal.cn: donate 也共享「给」词根：赠予。

abstract.en: Picture dark poison in a glass fading as a clear drop enters.
abstract.cn: 想象杯中黑毒随着一滴清液落入而褪色。

abstract.en: Picture a small vial arriving by courier just in time.
abstract.cn: 想象小药瓶被及时送到。

abstract.en: Picture a friend's joke popping like a pill against gloom.
abstract.cn: 想象朋友的玩笑像药片一样弹出，驱散阴郁。

examples.en: There is no antidote to this poison yet.
examples.cn: 这种毒目前尚无解药。

examples.en: Music was his antidote to city noise.
examples.cn: 音乐是他对抗城市噪音的解药。

examples.en: The antidote must be given within minutes.
examples.cn: 解毒剂必须在几分钟内使用。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「安替毒」——把毒安安稳稳替换掉的东西，就是「解毒剂」

root: 希腊语 anti-（对抗）+ didonai（给）→ antidoton（被给予以对抗之物）→ 拉丁 antidotum → 英语 antidote；核心意象是「递到手上的解药」。

sensesIntro.en: From the literal poison cure the word widens to any cure for the mind's poisons.
sensesIntro.cn: 由字面的解毒之药扩展到一切解「心中之毒」的东西。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: the counter-gift pressed into a poisoned hand
core.cn: 核心意象：被塞进中毒者手中的那件「反向馈赠」

branches.en: The clinic line: vials and serums against real toxins.
branches.cn: 临床线：对抗真实毒物的药瓶与血清。

branches.en: The metaphor line: boredom, gloom, and fear also get their antidotes.
branches.cn: 隐喻线：无聊、阴郁与恐惧也有各自的解药。

branches.en: Both answer something already inside the body or mind.
branches.cn: 两者都针对已进入身体或心里的东西。

branches.en: The timing line: an antidote works only if given in time.
branches.cn: 时机线：解药只有在及时给予时才有效。

branches.en: The garden line: even a walk can be dosed as a cure.
branches.cn: 生活线：连散步也可以像药一样按时服用。

intro.en: The word shows anti- 'against' plus the did- give-root plus the noun ending -ote.
intro.cn: 这个词含 anti-「对抗」、did-「给」词根与名词词尾 -ote。

latinIntro.en: The Latin entry shows antidotum, the borrowing that carried the word westward.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁条目展示 antidotum，即把该词带入西方的借形。

items.example: It supplies the against in antidote.
items.exampleCN: 它为 antidote 提供对抗义。

items.example: It appears in dose, donate, date.
It shares the give-root via Latin donum.
items.exampleCN: 它经拉丁语 donum 共享「给」词根。

scene: 博物馆把断臂石雕与磨圆的钱币并置展出，说明它们来自地中海世界的古代。The museum placed the broken-armed statue beside worn coins and explained that both came from antiquity in the Mediterranean world.
sceneCN: 这里 antiquity 指「地中海世界的远古时期」（第 1 个义项：遥远的古代）；句意为博物馆把断臂石雕与磨圆的钱币并置展出，说明它们来自地中海世界的古代。可辨识物件：玻璃柜、断臂石像、磨圆铜钱、年代标签。

pos.zh: 古代；远古时期；古代遗物（复数 antiquities）；古老（不可数）

collocations.zh: 古典古代（希腊罗马时期）

derivatives.zh: 古董；古式的
古代的；古老的
过时的；陈旧的
古物研究者（的）
古代文物（复数）

senses.title: The distant ancient past
senses.definition: the far past, especially the period of the ancient Mediterranean and Near Eastern world
senses.definitionCN: 遥远的过去，尤指古代地中海与近东世界的时期
senses.example: The harbour was already silted up in antiquity.
senses.exampleCN: 这个港口在古代就已淤塞。
senses.why: antiquity names a period by its distance from us, not by any event that starts or ends it.
senses.whyCN: antiquity 以与我们的距离来命名一个时期，而非以某个起点或终点事件。

senses.title: The ancient world as a whole
senses.definition: ancient societies and their cultures taken together as a field of study
senses.definitionCN: 把古代社会及其文化合为一个研究领域
senses.example: Scholars of antiquity compare Greek, Persian and Egyptian records.
senses.exampleCN: 古代世界的研究者比较希腊、波斯与埃及的记录。
senses.why: the singular collective sense lets one word stand for many societies that never met.
senses.whyCN: 单数集合义让一个词代表许多彼此未曾相遇的社会。

senses.title: Ancient objects and sites
senses.definition: physical remains of ancient life, usually in the plural, as in antiquities
senses.definitionCN: 古代生活的实物遗存，通常用复数 antiquities
senses.example: The customs office stopped the export of antiquities without a permit.
senses.exampleCN: 海关制止了无许可证的古代文物出口。
senses.why: the plural shifted the word from a period to the things that survive from it.
senses.whyCN: 复数形式把这个词从「时期」转向「从该时期留存下来的物件」。

senses.title: The quality of being very old
senses.definition: great age, measured by the distance between an object's origin and the present
senses.definitionCN: 以物件起源与当下的距离来衡量的久远程度
senses.example: The oak's antiquity is measured in rings, not in dates.
senses.exampleCN: 这棵橡树的古老程度以年轮而非年代来衡量。
senses.why: the abstract sense turns a period name into a measurable quality that any object can have.
senses.whyCN: 抽象义把时期名称变成任何物件都可以拥有的可测属性。

senses.title: An object surviving from ancient times
senses.definition: a single old object or building treated as a relic of the ancient past
senses.definitionCN: 被当作远古遗物的单件古物或建筑
senses.example: The carved seal is an antiquity of the first dynasty.
senses.exampleCN: 这枚刻纹印章是第一王朝的一件古代遗存。
senses.why: the countable form lets curators speak of one relic, while the plural names a collection.
senses.whyCN: 可数形式让策展人能说单件遗物，而复数则指一批收藏。

senses.title: Ancient style or appearance
senses.definition: the look or manner of something made long ago or made to seem so
senses.definitionCN: 久远之物（或仿古之物）的外观或做法
senses.example: The room imitates the antiquity of a Roman courtyard.
senses.exampleCN: 这个房间模仿罗马庭院的那种古意。
senses.why: design borrows the word for an effect, since age can be copied even when it cannot be owned.
senses.whyCN: 设计借这个词指一种效果，因为年代可以被模仿，即使无法真正拥有。

senses.title: The classical tradition
senses.definition: the Greek and Roman heritage as a continuing source for later art and thought
senses.definitionCN: 作为后世艺术与思想持续源头的希腊罗马遗产
senses.example: The architect studied antiquity before drawing the museum's facade.
senses.exampleCN: 建筑师在设计博物馆立面之前研究过古典传统。
senses.why: the Renaissance made a specific past into a permanent model, and that model kept the name.
senses.whyCN: 文艺复兴把一段特定过去变成永久范本，这个范本沿用了这个词。

senses.title: Abstract: something long out of date
senses.definition: used loosely for ideas or practices felt to belong to a vanished age
senses.definitionCN: 宽泛指让人觉得属于已逝时代的观念或做法
senses.example: The rule against left-handed desks is an antiquity of another era.
senses.exampleCN: 禁止左手书桌的规定是另一个时代的古董。
senses.why: the abstraction keeps only the distance in time and drops the archaeology entirely.
senses.whyCN: 抽象用法只保留时间上的距离，完全去掉考古内容。

intro.en: Antiquity comes from Latin antiquitas 'old age, the old times', from antiquus 'former, ancient', built on ante 'before'. It entered English through French. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: antiquity 来自拉丁 antiquitas「老年、旧时」，出自 antiquus「先前的、古老的」，其词根为 ante「在……之前」。它经法语进入英语。年代均为约数。

items.en: Ante meant 'before, in front of'; it is generally taken to continue a Indo-European root for 'before', though the exact form is reconstructed.
items.cn: ante 意为「在……之前、在前方」；一般被认为延续了印欧语中表示「在前」的词根，但确切形态属于重构。

items.en: Antiquus meant 'former, old, ancient', literally 'being before'; the suffix attached to ante is not fully explained.
items.cn: antiquus 意为「先前的、旧的、古老的」，字面是「在前的存在」；加在 ante 上的词尾尚未得到完整解释。

items.en: Antiquitas named old age and the old times, used of both persons and periods.
items.cn: antiquitas 指老年与旧时，既可用于人，也可用于时期。

items.en: Old French antiquité brought the word into English in the fourteenth century, first as 'oldness' and then as 'the old times'.
items.cn: 古法语 antiquité 于 14 世纪把该词带入英语，先指「古老」，继而指「旧时」。

items.en: From the seventeenth century the plural was used for the objects and monuments surviving from ancient times.
items.cn: 自 17 世纪起，复数形式被用于指从古代留存下来的物件与遗迹。

items.en: Source uncertain (first date and morphological detail): the earliest citation for the 'relics' sense is not fixed, and the formation of antiquus from ante is not fully explained, so the suffix analysis offered here is a reconstruction.
items.cn: 来源不确定（首见年代与形态细节）：「遗物」义的最早书证尚无定论；antiquus 由 ante 构成的方式未得到完整解释，此处对词尾的分析属于重构。

note.en: Group one holds the same-root words that are constantly confused; group two holds terms for the ancient world and for things that are merely old.
note.cn: 第一组是同根、极易混淆的词；第二组是古代世界与「只是旧」之物的术语。

entries.definition: From Latin ante through French ancien: it describes what belongs to the distant past, while antiquity names that period or its remains.
entries.definitionCN: 经法语 ancien 来自拉丁 ante：形容属于遥远过去之物，而 antiquity 指那个时期或其遗存。

entries.definition: From the same antiquus: a decorative object of some age, or a style copied from the past; it does not name a historical period.
entries.definitionCN: 同出 antiquus：指有一定年代的装饰性物件，或仿古风格；不指历史时期。

entries.definition: Made obsolete: it describes things judged old-fashioned rather than ancient, and often carries disapproval.
entries.definitionCN: 指已废弃：描述被判定为老派而非古老之物，常含贬义。

entries.definition: One who collects or studies old objects; the person form, not the period or the relic.
entries.definitionCN: 收藏或研究古物的人；指人，而非时期或遗物。

entries.definition: The everyday term for the societies of antiquity, especially Greece and Rome; it names the same field without the formality.
entries.definitionCN: 指古代社会的日常说法，尤指希腊与罗马；指同一领域，只是不那么正式。

entries.definition: The period before written records, which lies earlier than antiquity as usually defined.
entries.definitionCN: 指成文记录之前的时期，按通常定义比古代更早。

entries.definition: What is inherited from the past and valued now; it includes antiquities but also later buildings and customs.
entries.definitionCN: 从过去继承并被珍视之物；包含古代文物，也包含更晚的建筑与习俗。

entries.definition: A single object that survives from an earlier time; it is one item, while antiquities is a category.
entries.definitionCN: 从更早时代留存下来的单件物品；它是一件，而 antiquities 是一个类别。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real set phrases and real word relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: The root is ante, before, so antiquity is literally the time before.
normal.cn: 词根是 ante「在前」，所以 antiquity 字面上就是「之前的时间」。

normal.en: The family runs ancient, antique, antiquated, antiquarian and antiquities.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 ancient、antique、antiquated、antiquarian 与 antiquities。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the uses: in antiquity, classical antiquity, late antiquity.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出用法：在古代、古典古代、古代晚期。

normal.en: Plural antiquities means objects; the singular usually means the period.
normal.cn: 复数 antiquities 指文物；单数通常指时期。

normal.en: Keep antique for a valuable old object and antiquated for something merely out of date.
normal.cn: 把 antique 用于有价值的旧物，antiquated 用于单纯过时之物。

abstract.en: Picture a glass case holding a statue with a missing arm.
abstract.cn: 想象玻璃柜里立着一尊缺臂的石像。

abstract.en: Picture a coin worn smooth by centuries of hands.
abstract.cn: 想象一枚被无数双手磨得光滑的钱币。

abstract.en: Picture a rule still posted on a wall that no longer applies.
abstract.cn: 想象一条仍贴在墙上、却已不适用的规定。

examples.en: The city's walls have stood since antiquity.
examples.cn: 这座城的城墙自古代起就矗立至今。

examples.en: Trade in antiquities is restricted by international agreement.
examples.cn: 古代文物的交易受国际协定限制。

examples.en: Late antiquity saw the slow end of the classical city.
examples.cn: 在古代晚期，古典城市缓慢走向终结。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「anti（前）+ quity（古）」——在我们之前的久远年代 → 古代

root: 拉丁 antiquitas「老年、旧时」，出自 antiquus「先前的、古老的」，词根 ante「在……之前」；antiquus 由 ante 构成的具体方式未完全解释。英语 antiquity。

sensesIntro.en: Eight meanings follow one word from the distant period to the ancient world as a field, its surviving objects, the quality of age, a single relic, an antique look, the classical tradition and finally anything out of date.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿同一个词展开：从遥远时期，到作为研究领域的古代世界、留存文物、古老属性、单件遗存、仿古外观、古典传统，最后是任何过时之物。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a glass case with a broken-armed statue and a worn coin.
core.cn: 核心意象：玻璃柜中一尊断臂石像与一枚磨圆的钱币。

branches.en: PERIOD AND FIELD: the same distance in time becomes a subject of study.
branches.cn: 时期与领域：同一段时间距离变成一门研究对象。

branches.en: THINGS LEFT: plural and singular divide a collection from one relic.
branches.cn: 留下之物：复数与单数把一批收藏与单件遗存分开。

branches.en: MEASURED AGE: any object can carry the quality the period name implies.
branches.cn: 可测的年龄：任何物件都能带上时期名称所暗示的属性。

branches.en: STYLE AND MODEL: age can be imitated, and a specific past can become a permanent example.
branches.cn: 风格与范本：年代可被模仿，某段特定过去可成为永久范例。

branches.en: SLIGHTLY COMIC DISTANCE: anything obsolete borrows the word for a laugh.
branches.cn: 略带戏谑的距离：任何过时之物都借这个词开玩笑。

intro.en: Antiquity is a Latin noun with an abstract ending, and its root ante also builds words about position and priority.
intro.cn: antiquity 是一个带抽象词尾的拉丁名词，其词根 ante 还构成表示位置与先后的一些词。

latinIntro.en: Latin ante and antiquus build ancient, antique, antiquities and ante itself appears in antecedent and anterior.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 ante 与 antiquus 构成 ancient、antique、antiquities，ante 本身出现在 antecedent 与 anterior 中。

items.example: The root places the past before us.
items.exampleCN: 词根把过去置于我们之前。
antiquus 描述先于现在之物。
古物研究者为印章编目。

items.example: The antecedent of the pronoun is unclear.
items.exampleCN: 该代词的前指对象不清楚。

definition_zh: 防腐的；杀菌的；消毒剂；冷漠超然的
definition_en: preventing the growth of disease-causing germs, or a substance that does this; also coldly impersonal
core_image: 手术室里银亮的器械和刺鼻的药水味
scene: 诊室的灯亮着，护士正把器械浸入药液。The nurse wiped the wound with antiseptic.
sceneCN: 这里 antiseptic 是「消毒剂」（第 2 个义项：用来杀菌防腐的物质）；句意为护士用消毒剂擦拭伤口。

pos.zh: （喻）冷漠超然的；无菌般洁净的

derivatives.zh: 由同根构成，义为「防腐；抗菌处理」
反义同根词，义为「感染的；脓毒的」
同根名词，义为「脓毒症；败血症」

senses.title: Preventing infection
senses.definition: describing substances or conditions that stop germs from growing and wounds from festering
senses.definitionCN: 指能阻止病菌繁殖、防止伤口化脓的物质或环境
senses.example: Antiseptic surgery dramatically cut deaths after operations.
senses.exampleCN: 无菌外科手术大幅降低了术后死亡率。
senses.why: Anti- means 'against' and septikos 'putrefying', so the word literally means 'against rot'.
senses.whyCN: anti- 表示「对抗」，septikos 意为「腐烂的」，字面即「对抗腐坏」。

senses.title: A germ-killing substance
senses.definition: a chemical applied to skin or wounds to kill or slow the growth of germs
senses.definitionCN: 涂敷于皮肤或伤口以杀灭或抑制病菌的化学制剂
senses.example: The nurse wiped the wound with antiseptic.
senses.exampleCN: 护士用消毒剂擦拭伤口。
senses.why: A word that names a quality easily names the thing carrying the quality.
senses.whyCN: 表示性质的词很容易转指带有该性质的东西。

senses.title: Coldly clean and impersonal
senses.titleCN: 冷漠超然的；无菌般洁净的
senses.definition: describing places or manners that are spotless yet strangely lifeless and unemotional
senses.definitionCN: 形容一尘不染却缺乏生气与情感的地方或态度
senses.example: The hotel lobby felt antiseptic, with no trace of anyone at home.
senses.exampleCN: 酒店大堂洁净得冷漠，没有一点生活的痕迹。
senses.why: The hospital's sterile cleanliness became the picture of any place scrubbed of feeling.
senses.whyCN: 医院无菌般的洁净，被引申为任何被擦去人情的场所的样子。

intro.en: Antiseptic pairs Greek anti 'against' with septikos 'putrefying', coined in the age of germ theory.
intro.cn: antiseptic 由希腊语 anti「对抗」与 septikos「腐烂的」组合而成，诞生于细菌理论时代。

items.en: The root *sehp- meant 'to rot, decay', giving Greek sepein 'to putrefy'.
items.cn: 词根 *sehp- 意为「腐烂」，衍生出希腊语 sepein「使腐败」。

items.en: anti meant 'against', and septikos meant 'causing putrefaction'.
items.cn: 希腊语 anti 意为「对抗」，septikos 意为「导致腐烂的」。

items.en: The English word was formed in the mid-eighteenth century from these Greek parts.
items.cn: 英语于十八世纪中叶用这两个希腊语成分构成此词。

items.en: Joseph Lister's antiseptic surgery turned the word into a milestone of medicine.
items.cn: 李斯特的抗菌外科手术使这个词成为医学里程碑。

items.en: Today the word covers real germ-killers and, by metaphor, any airless kind of cleanliness.
items.cn: 如今这个词既指真正的杀菌剂，也隐喻毫无生气的洁净。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers the sepsis family and anti- words; the near-meaning group collects germ-fighters.
note.cn: 形近组收 sepsis 词族与 anti- 词；近义组收集各种杀菌之物。

entries.definition: infected with putrefying germs
entries.definitionCN: 感染的；脓毒的，与本词同根且意义相反

entries.definition: a medicine that kills bacteria inside the body
entries.definitionCN: 抗生素，同样以 anti- 开头但作用于体内

entries.definition: free from germs, as in aseptic packaging
entries.definitionCN: 无菌的，词形相近，来自不同的否定前缀 a-

entries.definition: a chemical that cleans surfaces of germs
entries.definitionCN: 消毒液，多用于物体表面而非伤口

entries.definition: an agent that kills germs
entries.definitionCN: 杀菌剂

entries.definition: completely free from living germs
entries.definitionCN: 无菌的；消过毒的

normalIntro.en: Antiseptic means against the rot.
normalIntro.cn: antiseptic 就是「对抗腐烂」。

normal.en: anti- = against; septic = putrefying.
normal.cn: anti- 表示「对抗」，septic 表示「腐烂的」。

normal.en: Septic and antiseptic are opposites from one root.
normal.cn: septic 与 antiseptic 同根反义。

normal.en: Think of the ant before septic: an ant guards against germs.
normal.cn: 把 ant「蚂蚁」放在 septic 前：蚂蚁守护伤口免受病菌。

normal.en: Antiseptic acts on the skin; antibiotic acts inside the body.
normal.cn: antiseptic 用于体表，antibiotic 作用于体内。

normal.en: Antisepsis is the practice; antiseptic is the agent.
normal.cn: antisepsis 是处理方式，antiseptic 是药剂。

abstract.en: See the white glare of an operating theatre.
abstract.cn: 想象手术室的白色无影灯。

abstract.en: Smell the sharp sting of iodine.
abstract.cn: 想象碘酒刺鼻的气味。

abstract.en: See an empty marble corridor with no people at all.
abstract.cn: 想象一条空无一人的大理石走廊。

examples.en: Antiseptic surgery dramatically cut deaths after operations.
examples.cn: 无菌外科手术大幅降低了术后死亡率。

examples.en: The nurse wiped the wound with antiseptic.
examples.cn: 护士用消毒剂擦拭伤口。

examples.en: The hotel lobby felt antiseptic, with no trace of anyone at home.
examples.cn: 酒店大堂洁净得冷漠，没有一点生活的痕迹。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「安提赛提克」——安安稳稳地把「赛跑的细菌」提走克除，就是消毒剂的本事。

root: 源自希腊语成分：anti-「对抗」+ septikos「腐烂的」（词根 *sehp-「腐烂」）；十八世纪中叶经新拉丁语 antisepticus 进入英语。

sensesIntro.en: One Greek pair first fights germs, then names the fight's weapon, then cools into a metaphor for sterile lifelessness.
sensesIntro.cn: 这对希腊语成分先对抗病菌，再转指对抗的武器，最后冷却为「无菌般冷漠」的隐喻。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: silver instruments gleaming under a lamp that nothing dirty survives.
core.cn: 核心意象：灯下银亮的器械，任何污秽都无法存活。

branches.en: wounds kept from festering
branches.cn: 防止化脓的伤口处理

branches.en: a bottle of yellow liquid
branches.cn: 一瓶黄色药水

branches.en: a lobby scrubbed of feeling
branches.cn: 被擦去人情的大堂

branches.en: polite but lifeless talk
branches.cn: 客气而无生气的交谈

branches.en: the surgeon's germ-free ritual
branches.cn: 外科医生的无菌流程

intro.en: A Greek-built compound: one prefix of opposition, one root of decay.
intro.cn: 一个希腊式复合词：前缀表对抗，词根表腐坏。

latinIntro.en: The sept- root also lives in septic, sepsis and aseptic.
latinIntro.cn: sept- 词根还见于 septic、sepsis 与 aseptic。

definition_en: a word that means the opposite of another word
core_image: 跷跷板两端坐着 hot 与 cold
scene: 黑板上并排写着两个词，中间一条分隔线。Hot is the antonym of cold.
sceneCN: 这里 antonym 是「反义词」（第 1 个义项：与另一词意义相反的词）；句意为 hot 是 cold 的反义词。

derivatives.zh: 由本词加 -ous 构成，义为「反义的」
同缀反概念词，义为「同义词」
同缀词，义为「同音（形）异义词」

senses.title: A word of opposite meaning
senses.definition: a word whose meaning is the direct opposite of another word's meaning
senses.definitionCN: 意义与另一个词直接相反的词

senses.title: A feeling of worry
senses.definition: an uneasy feeling caused by uncertainty about what may happen
senses.definitionCN: 因不确定将会发生什么而产生的不安
senses.example: Her anxiety about the exam kept her awake.
senses.exampleCN: 对考试的焦虑让她睡不着。
senses.why: Latin anxietas came from anxius, 'choked, uneasy', which itself came from angere, 'to squeeze or strangle'; anxiety is literally a tightening in the chest.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 anxietas 来自 anxius「被扼住、不安的」，而 anxius 又来自 angere「挤压、扼住」；所以 anxiety 字面上就是胸口被收紧的感觉。

senses.title: A strong wish to do well
senses.definition: an eager but uneasy wish to please someone or to do something well
senses.definitionCN: 急于讨好某人或把事情做好，却又带着不安的心情
senses.example: He waited with anxiety to hear the judges' decision.
senses.exampleCN: 他急切不安地等着听评委的决定。
senses.why: The same tightening happens when you badly want an outcome, so the word covers eager longing as well as fear.
senses.whyCN: 当你非常想要某个结果时，胸口也会同样收紧，所以这个词既指恐惧也指急切的渴望。

senses.title: A medical condition
senses.definition: a clinical condition marked by persistent and excessive worry

senses.example: She was treated for anxiety after months of sleeplessness.
senses.exampleCN: 失眠数月之后，她因焦虑症接受治疗。
senses.why: When the ordinary tightening becomes constant and disabling, the same noun is used as the name of the disorder.
senses.whyCN: 当这种普通的紧绷变得持续且影响生活时，同一个名词就被用来命名这种病症。

senses.title: Quickly, at speed

intro.en: Apace is a- plus pace, from Middle English a pas, at a pace. Pace comes from Old French pas, from Latin passus, a step, from pandere, to stretch the leg.
intro.cn: apace 是 a- 加 pace，来自中古英语 a pas「以某种步速」。pace 来自古法语 pas，后者出自拉丁语 passus「一步」，而 passus 又来自 pandere「伸腿」。

items.en: Latin pandere meant to stretch or spread, and in walking it described stretching the leg out for a stride.
items.cn: 拉丁语 pandere 意为「伸展、展开」，在行走语境中指伸腿迈出一步。

items.en: Passus was the noun for a step or a pace, and also a Roman measure of about five feet. It gives pace, pass and passage.
items.cn: passus 是表示「一步、步幅」的名词，也是罗马约五英尺的长度单位。它产生 pace、pass 与 passage。

items.en: Old French pas kept the sense of a step, and the phrase a pas meant at a pace, at a walking rate.
items.cn: 古法语 pas 保留「一步」之义，短语 a pas 意为「以某种步速」，即按行走的速度。

items.en: Middle English wrote a pas as two words, with a- meaning on or in, the same prefix seen in asleep and abroad.
items.cn: 中古英语把 a pas 写成两个词，a- 意为「在……之中」，与 asleep、abroad 中的前缀相同。

items.en: The two words fused into apace, now a literary adverb used mainly with proceed, continue, grow and change.
items.cn: 两个词合成为 apace，如今是书面副词，主要与 proceed、continue、grow、change 连用。
